{-# LANGUAGE RecordWildCards #-}
module AuditAgent where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Monad (when, void, forM_)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout, withFile, IOMode(..), hPutStrLn)

data LogLevel = DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , aeLevel    :: LogLevel
  , aeSource   :: String
  , aeMessage  :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data AgentConfig = AgentConfig
  { cfgLogFile    :: FilePath
  , cfgMaxBuffer  :: Int
  , cfgMinLevel   :: LogLevel
  , cfgHooks      :: [AuditEntry -> IO ()]
  }

data AgentState = AgentState
  { stBuffer     :: MVar [AuditEntry]
  , stFlushLock  :: MVar ()
  , stDropCount  :: IORef Int
  , stHookRegistry :: MVar (Map.Map String (AuditEntry -> IO ()))
  }

newAgentState :: IO AgentState
newAgentState = do
  buf  <- newMVar []
  lock <- newMVar ()
  drops <- newIORef 0
  hooks <- newMVar Map.empty
  return AgentState
    { stBuffer = buf
    , stFlushLock = lock
    , stDropCount = drops
    , stHookRegistry = hooks
    }

registerHook :: AgentState -> String -> (AuditEntry -> IO ()) -> IO ()
registerHook AgentState{..} name hook = do
  modifyMVar_ stHookRegistry $ \m -> return (Map.insert name hook m)

unregisterHook :: AgentState -> String -> IO ()
unregisterHook AgentState{..} name = do
  modifyMVar_ stHookRegistry $ \m -> return (Map.delete name m)

logEntry :: AgentState -> AgentConfig -> LogLevel -> String -> String -> IO ()
logEntry st@AgentState{..} cfg level source msg = do
  when (level >= cfgMinLevel cfg) $ do
    now <- getCurrentTime
    let entry = AuditEntry now level source msg
    bufFull <- modifyMVar stBuffer $ \buf ->
      if length buf >= cfgMaxBuffer cfg
        then do
          atomicModifyIORef' stDropCount (\n -> (n + 1, ()))
          return (buf, True)
        else return (buf ++ [entry], False)
    when (not bufFull) $ do
      runHooks st entry
    when (bufFull || length msg > 512) $ do
      flushBuffer st cfg

runHooks :: AgentState -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
runHooks AgentState{..} entry = do
  hooks <- readMVar stHookRegistry
  forM_ (Map.elems hooks) $ \hook -> do
    void $ forkIO (hook entry)

flushBuffer :: AgentState -> AgentConfig -> IO ()
flushBuffer AgentState{..} AgentConfig{..} = do
  -- Take the flush lock to serialize flushes
  takeMVar stFlushLock
  entries <- modifyMVar stBuffer $ \buf -> return ([], buf)
  when (not (null entries)) $ do
    withFile cfgLogFile AppendMode $ \h -> do
      forM_ entries $ \e -> do
        hPutStrLn h (formatEntry e)
      hFlush h
  putMVar stFlushLock ()

formatEntry :: AuditEntry -> String
formatEntry AuditEntry{..} =
  show aeTimestamp ++ " [" ++ show aeLevel ++ "] " ++ aeSource ++ ": " ++ aeMessage

-- | Security-critical: audit trail integrity check
-- Verifies no entries were dropped and flushes remaining
finalizeAudit :: AgentState -> AgentConfig -> IO Bool
finalizeAudit st@AgentState{..} cfg = do
  drops <- readIORef stDropCount
  flushBuffer st cfg
  remaining <- readMVar stBuffer
  return (drops == 0 && null remaining)

-- | Monitor hook that re-logs security events at higher priority
-- This creates a feedback path through the logging system
securityEscalationHook :: AgentState -> AgentConfig -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
securityEscalationHook st cfg entry =
  when (aeLevel entry >= WARN) $ do
    logEntry st cfg ERROR "SecurityMonitor"
      ("ESCALATED: " ++ aeMessage entry)

startAgent :: AgentConfig -> IO AgentState
startAgent cfg = do
  st <- newAgentState
  registerHook st "security_escalation" (securityEscalationHook st cfg)
  void $ forkIO $ monitorLoop st cfg
  return st

monitorLoop :: AgentState -> AgentConfig -> IO ()
monitorLoop st cfg = do
  threadDelay 5000000  -- 5 seconds
  flushBuffer st cfg
  monitorLoop st cfg
